notes.title: Celebrating Achievements
notes.notes:
Some dedicated soul has completed escape the farm 100% and unlocked all 15 Achievements!

To celerate, we're running a sale of 20% off all new purchases, so if you're yet to buy, now's the best clucking opportunity!

notes.title: Saving saves
notes.notes:
Some users have been reporting that their saves aren't loading properly. This quick little fix makes sure that your hard-earned progress is maintained, so you don't need to do all those levels in one shot and can come back later.

Full patch notes:
- Fixed an issue where saves could fail to load for some users.
- Fixed an issue with unusual physics in the campaign map in some areas

notes.title: Double-jumps are no more
notes.notes:
It is with a twinge of regret that we have had to patch out the ability for players to double-jump. While this undocumented feature has been known about for quite some time, we originally decided to keep it in as a fun little secret mechanic that did no real harm.

However, it became apparent that this effectively broke the challenge of many of the levels, as almost all regular walls and fences ceased to become any sort of obstacle at all.

Thanks to those diligent players who raised this issue!

notes.title: Ropey Physics
notes.notes:
The ropey physics patch introduces a number of quality of life improvements to the gameplay of Escape the Farm, most noticeably those pesky ropes that tended to go a bit haywire if you pulled them too hard now behave themselves!

Other fixes include:
- Improvements to the physics of certain wooden boards
- Improvements to the terrain in some levels to prevent you leaving them early
- Improvements to the challenge times of some levels to make them more achievable

notes.title: Hotfix for saving
notes.notes:
- Fixes an issue where some user's security settings prevented loading their saves
This issue didn't affect the saving process, so exisitng saves are unaffected

notes.title: Game Release
notes.notes:
At long last Escape the Farm is released and avilable to download. Preen those parkour feathers and move up the pecking order now.

It's been a long road but we're finally there. A big thank you to the testing team for really raising the quality of the product up. We would never have got there without you!

Although it's now out there in the wild we know this is just the beginning! Stay tuned for game updates and enhancements.

notes.title: Full Control
notes.notes:
Less than a week to go until release! We've been working hard to fix those last few issues and polish things up. Escape the Farm is now fully compatible with all major brands of controllers, joystics and VR devices, so now you're not restricted to keyboard and mouse!

We've tied up controller testing and have also come to the end of our comprehensive playtesting (don't worry all you beta-testers, you'll still have access up until launch!)

notes.title: Achievements are Here
notes.notes:
Achievements have been added to the game, so you can now prove your escaping skills by showcasing how many levels you've completed, as well as additional challenges.

Achievements are now available for milestone numbers of challenge times and collectable eggs you've found, as well as for completing each island.

Get cracking to earn them all!
